name: The Elevator
source:
Running an errand means leaving your 28th-floor apartment. You take the elevator and notice your crush has stepped in. 

Do you say something?

[From [url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/636241]Newgrounds[/url]]
translation:
办事意味着离开28楼的公寓。你乘电梯，发现你的暗恋对象已经走了进来。

你说点什么吗？

[来自[url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/636241]Newgrounds[/url]]
